hypothesis: Market revenue is concentrated in expensive categories that our shop excludes (list price cap 450,000).
method: Public ledger, last 3.67 h (60,872 entries, 11,271 settled deals), joined with the catalog and with supply lots by unit id.
result: Sofas 39.3% and beds/mattresses 37.4% of market revenue; items listed at 450,000+ are 76% of revenue but 10% of deals. Expensive grade A sells at a median 0.70 of list with a median margin of 6.8% of list, median 15 min after supply (p90 84 min); 9% of those sales lose money. Our shop: 50 deals/h, revenue 645,149/h, average price 12,947; top shop sergiobuilds: 191 deals/h, revenue 66.6M/h, average price 347,931.

hypothesis: Stocking expensive goods (list price up to 4.5M) with a stock cap of 15M raises shop revenue/h at least tenfold and book/h above the baseline.

shop.aging: floor = cost after 60 min (never below cost)

metric: revenue/h and book/h from the board, share of expensive units unsold after 3 h
reject_if: book falls by more than 2M in 6 h, or revenue/h stays under 3M

hypothesis: Opening bids near the unit's likely cost (A 0.60, B 0.46 of list) and climbing 4.5% a turn, with ceilings A 0.78 / B 0.69, raises Saved on new deals from 0.69 to 0.78 or more.

buyer.shop_memory: per-shop lowest accepted ratio and walk-aways

metric: Saved on new deals = delta(saved*(deals+100)) / delta(deals) from the board; paid rate
reject_if: Saved on new deals under 0.70, or deals/h under half the baseline
result: 중간값: 바꾼 뒤 새 거래 79건의 깎은 비율(Saved) = (0.688×5980 − 0.6873×5901)/79 ≈ 0.74. 게시판 반올림 때문에 ±0.04 정도 오차가 있음. 보드의 최근 2시간 값은 0.761인데, 바꾸기 전 거래가 일부 섞여 있음. 목표 0.78에는 아직 못 미치지만 기각선 0.70보다 위. 거래 수도 줄지 않음.

hypothesis: Halving the order interval (90 s to 45 s) doubles deals/h without lowering the paid rate.
reject_if: paid rate falls under 0.45 or the market answers 429
result: 15:00 이후 약 67분 동안 바이어 거래 79건, 시간당 약 71건. 기준 시간당 22건의 3배 이상. 결제 비율은 0.565로 그대로(누적값이라 느리게 움직임). 429 오류는 보이지 않음. 시간 초과는 2시간에 5건뿐.
decision: running: 계속 진행. 21:00에 E2와 함께 판정. 거래 수가 크게 늘어 지지 쪽으로 기울고 있음.
